rv.q: On an amusing low-tech set by Sully Ross, the high-spirited cast of five actors—led by grade-A cuties Jimin Moon and Jay Armstrong Johnson as the central couple—score with nearly every shot they take.
Heated Rivalry: The Unauthorized Musical Parody is a mirthful and pleasant diversion.
The rest of the cast is terrific in multiple roles.
It’s these performers who give this show a surprising heft.
Thoroughly enjoyable, knowingly silly, and affectionate without becoming smug, Heated Rivalry: The Unauthorized Musical Parody understands precisely what fandom wants from a send-up like this.
The musical delivers a delightful queer romp, perfect for Pride month or anyone craving a chicken smoothie.
Luckily, wine moms and the rest of us will have this well-crafted, side-splitting theatrical sendup to help satisfy our cravings until then.
Funny as puck lyrics, nicely orchestrated catchy songs, and performances that really pop, all add up to a feel-good treat of a night out at the theatre.

cn.t: Critics praise this campy, surprisingly heartfelt spoof as exuberant fun that knows its audience. Strong performances from Broadway vets Johnson and Moon, clever songs, and raunchy humor deliver 80 minutes of crowd-pleasing entertainment.
